risks.action: assert the anchor matches exactly once AND read what it matched before acting
risks.basis: section 1.3 applies -- An anchor that still matches is not an anchor that still points at the right thing
risks.risk: an exact-string anchor verifies UNIQUENESS, never that it still points at the right code

risks.action: report what was NOT looked at; a scan that covered 31% and says "clean" is a wrong answer
risks.basis: section 1.7 applies -- A sampling window silently exempts what it does not reach
risks.risk: a fixed window or limit silently exempts whatever it does not reach
